text: The analysis was refused because none of the 500 submitted probes were present in any corpus cohort, so nothing could be scored. All 500 probes were missing, giving a 100 % missing rate. Only a tiny fraction of probes were found on the EPIC v1 platform (0.4 %) and none on the 450K platform, while the EPIC v2 platform contained all 500 probes but still did not meet the minimum requirement. The refusal code is “insufficient_probe_coverage”. No matches or scores were reported.
